subject: POC scoping & kickoff confirmation — Avery Labs reranking pilot
messages:
From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil@redwood.com>
To: Tom Reid <tom.reid@averylabs.com>, Eva Morales <eva.morales@averylabs.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Mar 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Quick recap + proposed POC scoping (owners, success metrics, access)

Hi Tom / Eva —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap and a proposed scoping doc so we can lock the kickoff. I captured the core asks and what Redwood will deliver in a focused 3–4 week pilot. Please skim and confirm owners / any hard constraints.

What we heard (pain & priority)
- Reranking throughput is a blocker: current pipeline struggles to handle peak traffic (spiky workloads, degraded tail latency).
- Cost sensitivity: need to reduce inference cost per rerank call — target is meaningful savings without sacrificing ranking quality.
- Latency SLO: p95 under 120ms for top-k rerank (current spikes to ~400ms during peaks).

POC goals (success criteria)
- Functional: integrate Redwood inference to replace your current reranker in a small test slice.
- Quality: <5% degradation in NDCG@10 (target >= 0.90 baseline) on the 2k eval prompt set.
- Performance/cost: reduce per-call compute cost by >=60% OR improve throughput 3x at equivalent cost.
- Reliability: p95 latency <120ms in test workloads that emulate peak bursts.

Proposed scope & milestones (4 weeks)
- Week 0 (this week): access + baseline collection (we'll run your traffic snapshot and collect metrics).
- Week 1: prompt sweep and baseline eval on 2k labeled examples; establish NDCG baseline.
- Week 2: quantization + batching tuning; validate throughput and latency.
- Week 3: full evaluation, cost breakdown, and handoff notes + playbook for production rollout.

Owners / roles
- Avery Labs: Tom Reid (Product lead), Eva Morales (Eng lead), Priya Singh (PM - will join ops).
- Redwood: Nikhil Sharma (AE / engagement lead), Ben Carter (Solutions Engineer), Monica Patel (Platform engineer, access/contact).

Access & dependencies (what we need from Avery)
1) Sample dataset: 2k labeled reranking pairs — ideally already redacted. If not, we can accept a redacted export.
2) Dev ingest endpoint and test API key (scoped to staging).
3) Short-lived SSH/console access or service account to run baseline jobs (details below).
4) Security contact for KMS/PII questions (we can work via SAML or signed NDA if needed).

Attachments / drive: I've uploaded a starter prompt set and a mutual action plan to the shared drive (link below). The prompt CSV includes a labeled 2k sample template and a small synthetic slice we can use immediately.

Immediate asks
- Confirm the internal owners listed above.
- Grant staging API key + sample dataset access (we've put a checklist in the Drive folder).
- Kickoff: Wed Apr 6 — can you confirm time? I proposed 10:00 AM PT (we can move earlier if needed).

If that all looks good I'll send a short kickoff agenda and calendar invite.

Cheers,
Nikhil Sharma

Nikhil — thanks for the clear summary. High level yes, this matches our priorities. A couple of clarifications / asks before we lock the schedule:

1) Data & security: our security team requires KMS details and an expected data retention window for any staging artifacts. Can Redwood support customer-managed keys (or outline the encryption-at-rest approach)? Please loop in whoever handles security.

2) Dataset redaction: the 2k labels contain user-identifying fields in a few columns. We will do a quick redact but need an assurance we don't need full PII to evaluate quality. If not, we'll provide a mapping table.

3) Kickoff time: we can do Wed Apr 6 but prefer 9:00 AM PT rather than 10:00.

Add Priya (PM) to the thread — she will coordinate internal test data and scheduling. We'll also bring Kevin Lin (security) on the next thread once you share the KMS note.

Tom Reid

Tom / team —

Great — thanks for the quick turnaround. Confirming next steps and KMS/security details below so you can loop Kevin in.

Security & KMS (short answer)
- Redwood supports both customer-managed keys (via KMS integrations) and platform-managed encryption. For the POC staging slice we recommend platform-managed encryption with a 30-day retention; for production-ready demos we can enable customer KMS.
- We will not persist raw PII in our shared evaluation buckets — the default workflow keeps sensitive fields redacted unless you explicitly provide a mapping table.

Access checklist (how to give us what we need)
- Staging API key (scoped, token name: avl-poc-staging; expiration: 30d).
- Sample dataset: upload redacted CSV to the Drive folder or share an S3 link with a staging IAM role. Use the template we uploaded (Avery_MVP_prompt_set_v1.csv).
- Optional: a read-only service account for running baseline jobs (if easier we can run everything from your staging endpoint using the API key).

Metrics & evaluation details (how we'll measure)
- Quality: NDCG@10 (2k eval set) — report mean + 95% CI; target >= 0.90 relative to your baseline.
- Latency: p50/p95/p99 numbers under a traffic profile; p95 target <120ms.
- Cost: tokens & compute cost estimate (we'll produce a per-1M-token cost delta for the config we test).

Kickoff logistics
- Confirmed: Wed Apr 6, 9:00 AM PT — I'll send a calendar invite shortly.
- Proposed agenda (30–45m): introductions, success criteria, handoff of access, runbook & quick baseline plan, Q&A.

I've uploaded the starter prompt set and a mutual action plan spreadsheet here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cAVERY-PoC  — files attached: Avery_MVP_prompt_set_v1.csv, AVL_mutual_action_plan.xlsx

If that looks good please grant the staging key and drop Priya / Kevin into the calendar invite so we can resolve security questions during kickoff.

Thanks — looking forward to it.
Nikhil
